verdict.rationale: Asking an AI assistant grounded questions across mail and calendar is a fair axis for an email and calendar service, but the evidence pack never documents any Fastmail AI assistant or natural-language Q&A over the inbox or calendar. The JMAP API, API tokens, and standard mail search are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers
